text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
For today's segment, we'll be exploring
a few
Umastagrammable spots popular
with today's
youth! Any of these places
would make for the
perfect weekend
vacation...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wowzers, these spots look super-duper!
I wanna
go...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But check'n out all these swanky places
seems
kinda scary... Maybe someday...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But I'm not ready yet!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! I can't believe we're really
here! Are...
are you sure this's okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
O-okey dokey! My knees're still shak'n,
but I'm
rar'n t'go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-actually, there's somewhere I wanna
go! There
should be some kinda makeup
store 'round here
somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I dunno if I can buy makeup
without my
friends help'n me out...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's a cafe I wanna try too. That
might be
better... but... Ngh... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I agree! We can eat someth'n sweet
and talk
strategy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's all so cute! I've never seen
anyth'n that
looks this
scrum-diddly-umptious!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And the menu's on one of those touch
screen
thingies! Everything's so delicate
and colorful and
cute!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? The button's not work'n...
What?!
Everything just disappeared!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! If you've decided, I can take
your order
directly! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Um, I'd like the Sweet Dream B
set!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And to drink... Ah, this one! The royal
honey
marshmallow milk tea!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! H-hot, please!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Got it! ♪
And for you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I did it! I ordered all on my own!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Look, they've got desserts to-go as well!
They
even ship all over the country!
Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! How'd you know?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's gotta be a third sense only city
people
have! I betcha this kinda thing's
as normal as
putt'n on your shoes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We spend the rest of the afternoon
exploring the
fashionable district until
the sun goes down.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-y'mean at the makeup store?! Don't
y'think we
ought t'take things one step
at a time?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-you don't say!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I guess start'n off with the toughest thing will make the rest easy-peasy in compar'son...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa, it's so sparkly! Everyth'n's so
cute, and
it smells sweeter'n a rose in
here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If I r'member right, Curren
told me I
should always try a sample
b'fore I buy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll start with this lipsti—huh? It's beige.
Wait,
what's... "concealer"?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? "Tint"? "Applicator included"?
Wh-what's
the diff'rence b'tween serum
and toner?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha... I don't know m'left from m'right
anymore!
Everything's so cute, but I can't
make heads or
tails of it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know much about makeup, but I
let her
know that she can probably just
look up how to
use everything online.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
By golly, you're a genius! I'll just hafta
find a
tutorial on UmaTube later!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I never woulda thought of that... Back
home, I
always learned stuff by read'n
magazines or
watch'n TV...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okay! In that case, I'm gonna buy
everyth'n my
gut says is cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We spend the rest of the afternoon
exploring the
fashionable district until
the sun goes down.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ I had so much fun t'day! I'm
glad I bit the
bullet and came here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And it's all thanks t'you, Trainer! Thanks
for com'n
with me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um! I know this is sudden, but I got
you
someth'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I actually bought it when y'went to the
bathroom
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I heard on TV that giv'n someone a
present when
you say goodbye shows
that you've got style.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-it's my way of say'n thanks. Maybe I'm
try'n a bit
too hard, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"You'll never know if you don't try!"
Right? So, I
wanted t'thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe... no, thank you. Hehe! And one more time for good measure!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much for com'n with me
today. 'Cause
of you, one of my dreams
came true.
